environment.description: EKS cluster (v1.28) in us-east-1. The user-service pod runs in the 'platform' namespace. The gRPC service is exposed via a Kubernetes Service of type LoadBalancer (AWS NLB) with no target group restrictions. The NLB security group allows inbound TCP/50051 from 0.0.0.0/0. No NetworkPolicy is applied to the namespace. Pod runs with default service account. MongoDB is accessible from any pod in the cluster without authentication beyond connection string credentials embedded in the code.
